propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone+strip driver seams, pure metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main.

The ~450-run live LLM batch replay for gate candidate evaluation is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in story d8a5 (change #798), which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible because the plan-v3 impact_model_version bump stranded sidecar baselines to ~4 rows versus ~200 needed, eliminating the rationale for expensive replay.

The replay design removes recall contamination (prior_concerns re-surfacing) and baseline drift via recall-stripped clone (delete REVIEW_RESULT.json), material-fingerprint drift guard, and two-tier nondeterminism isolation (fresh N=3 both gates, two-level median, current-vs-current null floor).

The pure e3_metrics library (build_matrix, criterion_deltas, tkey, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) is golden-tested offline with no LLM dependency and passes test_e3_metrics.py.
